narr: Hurricane Henri moved up the U.S. Atlantic coast and over parts of southeast New York on August 22 to 23, 2021. Bands of heavy rainfall crossed through parts of central New York producing flooding in some locations.
ev: There was flooding along Route 26 in and around the Village of Eaton.
Roads were washed out near CR-13 and Bamberry Road.
Flash flooding occurred on Route 26. Ditch scouring and a couple washouts were observed.
